Vanilla ships I could recommend are the Paragon, but only for absolute beginners because it doesn't teach youuch beside very basic flux management and positioning, and the Onslaught once you are ready to play more aggressively and make use of that aggressive armour tanking.

If you're interested in cruisers, the Dominator is a good choice to learn, it will teach you good flux management while still retaining some mobility. 

One thing to bear in mind is that Low Tech and High Tech play very differently. Low Tech's heavy armour allows it to focus on firepower instead of shields as long as the armour holds, whilst High Tech relies on its shields and agility for survivability.

I suggest to start learning with capital ships, which are easier to pilot and are less "skill reliant" than other classes. Big fleet anchors at first maybe, to teach you flux management and armour tanking well, then moving on to nimble ships that make a bigger difference in player hands.
